profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Crisis Solutions Services LLC
profile.summary: I'm very passionate about OpenSource software development.  Have solid experience with Python, Django, MySQL, cloud based servers (AWS, Linux, Ubuntu Server), and Amazon Web Service technologies (ELB, RDS, SES, etc), Ajax, REST/JSON, XML, SMS, etc.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed, coded, installed and tested an online self help service to improve couple relationships at	(http://www.kryzol.com) using LAMP (Linux/Apache/MySQL/Python) stack,  Python v3.5, Django 3.1 and MySQL database.  Also used GIT (github/gitlab), AWS cloud platform, SQS (Simple Message Queue), Celery, FirstData payment gateway.  The front-end was developed using bootstrap, JavaScript, AJAX.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and developed the PGT (Proposal Generating Tool) data exchange between PGT clients and WideOrbit advertising database REST API using Python 3.5 and Django.  This application uses PostgreSQL.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Python / Django / Apache / Ubuntu / AWS)
positions.description: Designed and developed a Django/Python based media content delivery system of over 1M users using Python 2.7, Django 1.4.1, MySQL, MongoDB, celery, RabbitMQ, haystack, memcached, fabric, git, SES (Simple Email Service), ELB on Ubuntu servers running on Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud.  Static media was served from AWS CDN servers administered using CloudBerry. Server performance and monitoring using Ylastic and WebMin.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developing a software tool for designing and engineering Tilt-Up walls.

You can see a YouTube demo of the application here:
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wv48uVk8txY

positions.title: .Net Contractor
positions.description: Developed .NET/C# web services for credit card processing.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and developed a medical coding and billing application.  Also developed a document imaging system and a medical chart application.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and developed an instant messaging and event notification server/client application using Python Medusa for the server and VB6 for the client side. Developed application to process an XML FAA flight data stream and alert system.
